title: Parliament Chamber
purpose: Legislatures sector card and parliamentary-vertical surfaces.
story: A legislative chamber between sessions — tiered benches curving toward an empty speaker's dais, the hush before debate.
environment: A grand semicircular debating chamber, tiered seating rising in concentric arcs around a central well.
architecture: Neoclassical parliament interior — a high coffered ceiling, ranked stone galleries, a raised presiding chair under a carved canopy.

people.notes: A handful of figures scattered in the lower benches, seen from behind and in shadow; no face toward the camera.

composition: The empty presiding dais on the central axis, curved benches sweeping outward, deep negative space rising into the dim galleries.
negativeExtra: any writing on benches or walls
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade with one warm source and brass-on-black palette; chamber darkness must match scene-01.
